title: NICHD's spotlight says children can learn nine new words a day from 18 months
summary: NICHD's 2017 spotlight says that from 18 months to preschool age, children can learn 9 new words each day.
body: Under research shows, the NICHD spotlight of 10 August 2017 says that from 18 months to preschool age, children can learn 9 new words each day. The verb on the page is can learn. The bullet does not say every child adds nine words every day, and it does not name the study next to the number. Two other bullets on that list are about recognizing people and a mirror, which are not this claim. The number is the spotlight's summary.

sources.title: Focus on Early Learning
sources.author: Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development
sources.note: US federal page, public domain. Opened 2026-11-26. Supports the bullet that from 18 months to preschool age, children can learn 9 new words each day.
